PharmR confirms the reviewer NOAEL of 20 mg/kg (0.7x) with LOAEL 100 mg/kg (brain focal arteritis), while the sponsor reported 100 mg/kg as the NOAEL. Furman confirms the WM 2000 mg dose came from CLL. Untested/no_prediction is defensible; see rule question.
Teeling 2004 abstract (PMID 15172969) ends with the quoted sentence verbatim. Furman's PMC text cites in-vitro CDC superiority as the rationale for the trial.

Abstract: the primary endpoint is ORR (CR+PR+MR) and the quote is verbatim. Registry results posted 2012-04-30 for NCT00811733 (confirmed). The model's 'improved' superiority over rituximab was never tested, so I'd add source_calls_it 'partial'. Status stays same.

PharmR states infection deaths were 'consistent with clinical observations' and that humans are more sensitive to infusion reactions, so same/partial with imported_from CLL is supported. Unscored predicted harms (haemolytic anaemia, brain arteritis at 3.5x) raise a rule question.

Bleeker 2008 abstract (Europe PMC, DOI resolves, online 2007-11-27) has the quote verbatim and states the 5-10 ug/mL maintenance target. Untested opening, class level, prospective. The 10 ug/mL half comes from the monkey arm of the same paper.

Furman 2017 PMC Table 5 row matches (TGA 23.4, TGB 181 ug/mL before dose 4). The target was stated by the model paper, not a sponsor trough. The trial started 2009, after the 2007 model, so not retro. Same holds.
Quote is verbatim in the Bleeker abstract, but I saw only the abstract. In-vivo xenograft kept as its own track apart from in-vitro CDC. Untested 2007, class level.

The 51%/59% ORR quote is verbatim in the Furman PMC text. ORR is primary, and the registry posting of 2012-04-30 sets the year. The model predates the 2009 trial, so this is prospective, not retro. Direction-only same is fine.

missing: NCT01536067 (ofatumumab + bortezomib, untreated WM, phase 2, terminated, results posted): a WM patient trial of a class member in combination. It belongs in patient_trials on the efficacy track and does not change the status.

No uncovered model system found: Europe PMC and a web search for ofatumumab, ublituximab or veltuzumab against WM cell lines (BCWM.1), xenografts or patient cells turned up nothing beyond Le Garff-Tavernier 2015. Veltuzumab has no WM data (its NCT00989586 is a B-NHL combination).
rule_questions: Dose: the sponsor's tox report states a NOAEL of 100 mg/kg (3.5x the clinical dose), which held in patients, but the FDA reviewer re-set the NOAEL to 20 mg/kg (0.7x) on brain arteritis. Whose stated margin counts as the model's margin_stated: the sponsor's, or the regulator's re-reading?

Safety: monkeys showed fatal haemolytic anaemia (which FDA called likely species-specific) and focal brain arteritis at 3.5x the clinical exposure, and neither was seen as such in patients. Does a harm the regulator discounted, or one seen only above human exposure, count as a 'predicted harm that never appeared' (contra/opposite)?
